_comment: Example of the editorial pass for refine_cuts.py (lecture-video Judgment 2). Times are seconds on the composite's clock, which is the recording's clock. Each range cuts every block whose middle lies inside it; the reason goes into the cut log. trim_starts: [block_start_s, search_from_s, search_to_s, reason] moves a block's start to the voice's rise after the pause found between the two search times. Spoken setting cues, empty blocks and lone fillers are cut automatically and need no entry. A lecture with nothing to cut takes {}.
cut_ranges: retake 1 of 2 of the welcome line (the second take is kept: it flows into the next line)
direction to the camera: 'hold on, I'll say that again'
handling noise while the microphone was adjusted
aside about the microphone (a test note, not lecture content)
false start, restarted at the next block
false start: the sentence is said again cleanly right after
trim_starts: stumble before the restart of the line
self-repair at the start of the block
